svg.title: Traditional VLA comparison figure
svg.desc: Base frames: f01 top traditional VLA maps language and multi-view images through a VLA model to an optimal driving action; f02 middle traditional VLA with CoT generates textual explanation; f03 bottom closed-loop VLA model with ToT-E and V-CoT produces multiple candidate actions, selection, optimal action, and next-scene generation with feedback. Original-like construction is present in editable SVG; confirmed SAM assets are bound at original crop coordinates for detailed icons and composite blocks while preserving arrows, captions, and outer logical frames.

g.text: (a) Traditional VLA directly maps multimodal inputs to driving
(b) Traditional VLA using CoT to generate only textual
